atDirectives.name: @import
atDirectives.description: Import Tailwind CSS with `@import "tailwindcss"` in v4.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Define design tokens as CSS variables. Use `@theme inline` when values should reference other CSS variables without re-emitting them.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Define a custom utility that works with variants.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Register a custom variant, such as class-based dark mode.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tell Tailwind which files to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Load a JavaScript Tailwind config file for backward compatibility.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Load a Tailwind plugin from CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use the native CSS @layer at-rule to control cascade.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use @apply to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.
